summary: Full regression for the new Accident/Incident module + searchable TopicPicker for Safety Meetings. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_incidents.py with 12 tests (CRUD on /api/incidents incl. full payload with root_causes, witnesses, photos, signatures; missing-required 422; double-DELETE 404; list summary shape with photo_count/severity/osha_recordable; created_at desc sort; _id excluded) plus regression probes for /api/inspections, /api/meetings, /api/jhas list endpoints. Combined suite: 39/39 PASS. Frontend: Hub renders all 4 tiles (hub-tile-inspections|meetings|jha|incidents) with API-driven counts. /meetings/new TopicPicker (data-testid=topic-picker-trigger) opens, renders all 81 topics grouped by category; searching 'silica' filters to exactly 1 match 'Concrete Operations & Respirable Silica'; selecting it prefills the Topic input; selecting Custom Topic clears the Topic input. /incidents/new renders all 6 severity buttons (severity-near_miss/first_aid/medical/restricted/lost_time/fatality), the active button gets the red-700 border treatment, Section 03 (Person Involved) follows the documented OR predicate (incident_type==Injury/Illness OR severity in {first_aid,medical,restricted,lost_time,fatality}). /incidents dashboard exposes new-incident-btn and share-incident-form-btn. /incidents/submit public mode renders the form and (correctly) does NOT render the back-link to /incidents (a[href='/incidents'] absent).
action_items: Optional: server.py is now ~548 lines with 4 resource families. Next module should split into routers/{inspections,meetings,jhas,incidents}.py with shared models. Not blocking.
Optional: IncidentCreate uses ConfigDict(extra='allow') — convenient for an evolving form, but flags an unvalidated-fields surface area worth noting.

Optional carry-over from iteration_3/4: ViewInspection.jsx recomputes the grade via computeGrade(data) instead of preferring persisted score/status fields; historic records would silently re-grade if the algorithm changes. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 POST endpoints correctly pop _id after insert_one and rely on response_model; list endpoints use projection {_id:0}. Verified empirically — no _id leaked in any of the 39 test responses.

NewIncident.isInjury predicate is `type == 'Injury / Illness' || severity in {first_aid..fatality}`. Because buildIncidentDefaults() defaults incident_type to 'Injury / Illness', Section 03 is visible by default — this matches the spec ('Injury/Illness type OR non-near-miss severity'), but is worth calling out: changing the default type to blank (and forcing user selection) would also hide Section 03 by default and avoid surprising users on a near-miss flow.
TopicPicker uses cmdk with a custom filter on `${title} ${category} ${key}` lowercased substring — correctly matched 'silica' to exactly 1 of 81 topics in live test. Good.
IncidentsDashboard severity badge: severityOf() falls back to SEVERITY_LEVELS[0] when key is missing — defensive. OSHA badge correctly only renders when osha_recordable === 'Yes'.

Public-mode routing: /incidents/submit correctly hides the back-link (verified via DOM probe), navigates to /thank-you on submit (per NewIncident.submit), and ShareFormDialog uses /incidents/submit path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on probed routes/testids: Hub (4 tiles), /meetings/new (TopicPicker open, 81 items, silica filter, custom clears), /incidents/new (all 6 severity buttons, active class, Section 03 predicate), /incidents (new + share buttons), /incidents/submit (form rendered, back-link hidden). End-to-end Submit-an-Incident clicks (filling all fields + signature canvas drag + view page render) were not exercised this run; covered by the API-level POST/GET/_id-exclusion tests.

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates 2 TEST_INC_* incident records (Lift_NearMiss + NearMiss), the medical one is deleted by test_delete_incident_then_404 and the near_miss one by test_cleanup_near_miss. Plus the existing 4 TEST_GRADE_* + TEST_TBT_ + TEST_JHA_ records from prior iterations are also created/cleaned within the same run. No residual TEST_ data after pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test files: /app/backend/tests/test_inspections.py (13), test_meetings_jhas.py (14), test_incidents.py (12 incidents + 3 regression list-probes) = 39 total. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Hub testids: hub-tile-{inspections|meetings|jha|incidents}. Incident testids: severity-{near_miss|first_aid|medical|restricted|lost_time|fatality}, root-cause-{key}, witness-add, witness-name-{i}, witness-statement-{i}, reporter-sig, supervisor-sig, submit-top-btn, submit-bottom-btn, new-incident-btn, share-incident-form-btn, severity-badge-{id}, view-{id}, delete-{id}. TopicPicker testids: topic-picker-trigger, topic-picker-content, topic-picker-search, topic-picker-custom, topic-picker-item-{key}. Note the OLD select-topic-template / topic-template-{key} ids are GONE. Section 03 visibility predicate: incident_type==='Injury / Illness' OR severity in {first_aid,medical,restricted,lost_time,fatality} — and the form defaults incident_type to 'Injury / Illness' so Section 03 is visible by default. Public mode route: /incidents/submit -> navigates to /thank-you on submit (not back to dashboard).
rca of the issue: No new bugs identified this iteration. Two carry-over notes (server.py file size > 500 lines after 4th module; ViewInspection grade recompute) remain optional. Section 03 always-visible-by-default is intended given the OR predicate + default incident_type.
